title: Shop Efficiency leaves a no-charge line's estimate out of invoiced hours
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have technician A for this test.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours and line 2 of 1.5 estimated hours marked No Charge, on which technician A clocked 1.0 hour.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Shop Efficiency.
  2. Set the date range to today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report opens.

Step 2:

  • Invoiced hours count line 1's 2.0 and not line 2's 1.5.
  • Line 2's 1.0 clocked hour counts as worked hours.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R8: “Shop Efficiency, Technician Utilization and Timesheets keep clocked hours on internal and no-charge work orders and on no-charge lines as worked hours; Shop Efficiency leaves a no-charge line's estimated hours out of invoiced hours; the existing "Internal Hours" column (time clocked to a department, not to a work order) is unchanged and unrelated.”
